text:
liam: just kicked off an onboarding eval for 'heron-lite' with int6 per-channel quant and no post-norm. numbers look... odd. recall@10 down but throughput great. can someone glance?

anya: got the job id?

liam: `eval_2026_03_21_01` config: `--model heron-lite --quant=int6 --per_channel=true --post_norm=false --k=10 --seed=7`

devin: pulling the summary:
```
model       r@1    r@5    r@10   silhouette  mean_norm  qps
fp16        0.481  0.753  0.821  0.36        8.4        16.1
int6_pc     0.467  0.737  0.796  0.29        6.2        29.3
```

liam: yikes mean_norm drop from 8.4 -> 6.2. that could break our knn thresholds. any embedding distribution plots?

anya: uploaded UMAP + norm histogram to artifacts: https://staging-artifacts/redwood/heron-lite/eval_2026_03_21_01/plots

devin: quick hypothesis: per-channel rounding hurting late-layer signals. two quick experiments: (1) L2 normalize before indexing, (2) enable post_norm during quant to preserve scale.

liam: I'll try (1) first. running `python tools/recalc.py --id eval_2026_03_21_01 --normalize` on a 75k subset.

ci-bot: smoke checks passed for eval_2026_03_21_01  artifacts: /artifacts/eval_2026_03_21_01 (12 files)

anya: normalize run finished: int6_pc (normalized) r@10 = 0.810 vs fp16 0.821; silhouette up to 0.33. recovered ~65% of gap.

devin: good. next: can we test post-norm quant? that should keep mean closer to fp16 without changing index-time normalization expectation.

liam: kicked off `eval_2026_03_21_02` with `--quant=int6 --per_channel=true --post_norm=true`. will report once done.

ops: FYI i'll schedule a tiny canary in staging serving: route 2% traffic to int6_pc with an override that forces L2-normalize pre-index. will monitor recall signals and error rates.

ci-bot: eval_2026_03_21_02 complete  status: SUCCESS. artifacts: /artifacts/eval_2026_03_21_02

devin: post_norm run results: r@10 = 0.817, silhouette = 0.34, mean_norm = 8.1, qps ~27.8. pretty close to fp16 now.

liam: excellent. operational plan then: (A) keep per-channel int6 but enable post-norm quant config, (B) apply L2-normalize at index time as a safety net for legacy indexes, (C) run small live canary 2% for 48h.

anya: agree. also add a faiss-params sweep (efSearch / efConstruction) to see if index tuning can recover performance without post-norm in case we want simpler quant pipeline.

devin: logging tickets: RED-ML-1299 (post-norm rollout), RED-OPS-230 (canary + monitoring dashboard). assigning liam + ops.

liam: putting notes & plots into audit: https://redwood-internal/evals/heron-lite-int6-audit. thanks all. :thumbsup:
